name: @wildflowerhealthio/suggested-apps-core
description: The schema of `https://wildflowerhealth.io/suggested_apps.json`, which the marketing site publishes: the SMART apps worth trying with a Wildflower server, each tagged and explained. `SuggestedApps` (the document), `SuggestedApp`, the closed `SuggestedAppTag` list with its `TAG_LABELS`, and where the file is published (`SUGGESTED_APPS_PATH`, `SUGGESTED_APPS_URL`). No React, no DOM.
